name: Hidden Valley Original Ranch Dressing (High Dairy & Allium Warning)
whyItWorks: A potent multi-trigger dressing: combines cultured buttermilk and sour cream (lactose/fat) with high concentrations of dried garlic powder, dried onion, and herb flecks. One of the top self-reported sauce triggers for sudden cramping and urgent diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Trigger Warning: Avoid commercial buttermilk ranch during flares. Choose a low-FODMAP garlic-free dressing or plain avocado oil mayo mixed with salt and dill.
watchOuts: High lactose, heavy saturated fat, and concentrated allium powders stimulate acute intestinal hypermotility.
